name: Wall-Supported Handstand Push-Ups
how_to:
Step 1: Warm Up Properly

- Perform wrist, shoulder, and triceps stretches to increase mobility.
- Activate the core with plank holds and pike push-ups.
Step 2: Get Into Position

- Place your hands shoulder-width apart on the ground, about 6 to 12 inches away from a wall.
- Kick up into a handstand position, keeping your core tight and legs straight.
- Rest your heels lightly against the wall for support.
Step 3: Lower into the Push-Up

- Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the ground in a controlled motion.
- Keep your elbows at a 45-degree angle to protect your shoulders.
- Lower yourself until your head lightly touches the ground or a mat.
Step 4: Press Back Up

- Engage your shoulders, triceps, and core to push back to the starting position.
- Keep your arms straight and shoulders active at the top.
- Maintain control throughout the movement to prevent imbalance.
